python3 -c "
import sys, json, re
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
fp = d.get('tool_input', {}).get('file_path', '')
content = d.get('tool_input', {}).get('content', '') or d.get('tool_input', {}).get('new_string', '')

violations = []

# No service/store/hook files directly in pages/
if re.search(r'(apps/[^/]+/)?src/pages/.*\.(service|store|hook|query|slice|api)\.(ts|tsx)$', fp):
    violations.append('Service/store/hook/slice files belong in src/services/, src/features/<name>/, or packages/* — not in src/pages/.')

# No components dumped directly in src/ or apps/<x>/src/ root
if re.search(r'(apps/[^/]+/)?src/[A-Z][a-zA-Z]+\.(tsx|ts)$', fp):
    violations.append('Components must live in src/components/, src/features/<name>/components/, or packages/ui/* — not directly in src/.')

# No direct cross-feature imports
feature_match = re.search(r'src/features/([^/]+)', fp)
if feature_match:
    current = feature_match.group(1)
    cross = [m for m in re.findall(r\"from ['\\\"]@/features/([^/'\\\"]+)\", content) if m != current]
    if cross:
        violations.append(f'Cross-feature import detected ({current} → {cross}). Share via packages/ui, packages/utils, or a feature-agnostic store slice.')

# No deep relative imports across packages
if re.search(r\"from ['\\\"]\\.\\./\\.\\./\\.\\./packages/\", content):
    violations.append('Use the workspace package name (`@app/ui`, `@app/utils`) instead of a deep relative path across packages.')

# No default exports for components
if fp.endswith('.tsx') and re.search(r'(src|packages/ui)/(components|features|pages)/', fp):
    if re.search(r'^export default ', content, re.MULTILINE):
        violations.append('Use named exports only — no default exports for components.')

# No inline styles — vanilla-extract only
if fp.endswith('.tsx') and 'style={{' in content:
    violations.append('No inline styles — define styles in a sibling .css.ts file (vanilla-extract).')

# No Tailwind className utilities (rough heuristic: many tw-style classes in one className)
if fp.endswith('.tsx') and re.search(r'className=\"[^\"]*\\b(bg-|text-|p[xytrbl]?-|m[xytrbl]?-|flex\\b|grid\\b)[^\"]*\\s+[^\"]*\\b(bg-|text-|p[xytrbl]?-|m[xytrbl]?-|flex\\b|grid\\b)', content):
    violations.append('Tailwind utility classes detected — this stack uses vanilla-extract. Move styles into a .css.ts file.')

# No `any` type
if fp.endswith(('.ts', '.tsx')) and re.search(r':\s*any\b', content):
    violations.append('Avoid `any` — use `unknown` and narrow types, or define a discriminated union.')

# No new WebSocket() outside ws-client / services/ws
if fp.endswith(('.ts', '.tsx')) and 'new WebSocket(' in content and not re.search(r'(packages/ws-client|src/services/ws)/', fp):
    violations.append('Open WebSocket connections only inside packages/ws-client/ or src/services/ws/. Components must subscribe via hooks.')

if violations:
    reason = 'traffic-one — architecture violation(s):\n' + '\n'.join(f'  • {v}' for v in violations)
    print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'PreToolUse', 'permissionDecision': 'deny', 'permissionDecisionReason': reason}}))
"

python3 -c "
import sys, json, re
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
cmd = d.get('tool_input', {}).get('command', '')

# Only check install commands
if not re.search(r'(npm (install|i|add)|yarn add|pnpm add|bun add)', cmd):
    sys.exit(0)

forbidden = [
    ('mobx', 'Use Redux Toolkit for global business state and zustand for ephemeral UI state.'),
    ('recoil', 'Use Redux Toolkit for global business state and zustand for ephemeral UI state.'),
    ('jotai', 'Use Redux Toolkit for global business state and zustand for ephemeral UI state.'),
    ('styled-components', 'Use vanilla-extract for build-time static CSS.'),
    ('@emotion', 'Use vanilla-extract for build-time static CSS.'),
    ('tailwindcss', 'Use vanilla-extract — no runtime CSS framework on this stack.'),
    ('@mui/', 'Build shared primitives in packages/ui on top of vanilla-extract.'),
    ('antd', 'Build shared primitives in packages/ui on top of vanilla-extract.'),
    ('material-ui', 'Build shared primitives in packages/ui on top of vanilla-extract.'),
    ('chakra-ui', 'Build shared primitives in packages/ui on top of vanilla-extract.'),
    ('bootstrap', 'Build shared primitives in packages/ui on top of vanilla-extract.'),
    ('swr', 'Use RTK Query for cached server state.'),
    ('vitest', 'This stack uses Jest for unit/integration and @playwright/test for E2E.'),
    ('@vitest/', 'This stack uses Jest for unit/integration and @playwright/test for E2E.'),
    ('next\\b', 'This plugin targets Turborepo + Vite apps, not Next.js.'),
    ('(?<!tanstack/)(?<!\\w)react-query(?!-)', 'Use RTK Query, or @tanstack/react-query if you really need it (RTK Query is preferred).'),
]

hits = [(lib, tip) for lib, tip in forbidden if re.search(lib, cmd)]
if hits:
    lines = '\n'.join(f'  • {lib}: {tip}' for lib, tip in hits)
    reason = f'Forbidden library detected:\n{lines}\n\nSee rules/core.md for the approved stack.'
    print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'PreToolUse', 'permissionDecision': 'deny', 'permissionDecisionReason': reason}}))
"
